title: Tawakoni Boat Rental
specs: Boats equipped with cameras, GPS geofencing, and real-time safety monitoring
Captain required for those who do not meet boat operator requirements
Maximum capacity 12 passengers on pontoons; capacity may decrease due to weight limits
includes: All safety equipment including life vests
Bluetooth stereo system, Bimini canopy, Lowrance Fish Finder with GPS
blurb: Tawakoni Boat Rentals offers multiple well-maintained pontoon party barges for rent 7 days a week with options for 4hr, 6hr, 8hr, 12hr, and multiple day rentals starting as early as sunrise. Captains are available for hire at $20 per hour plus gratuity for those less experienced in motorized boat operation. The boats are equipped with safety gear, Bluetooth stereo, GPS fish finder, and other amenities for a safe and enjoyable experience.
extraNote: Security deposits for all renter cancellations are non-refundable · Same day cancellations are non-refundable with full charge of rental fee and deposit · Credit vouchers issued only if operator cancels due to hazardous weather conditions · Fuel costs are renter's responsibility and deducted from security deposit or charged separately · Late fees apply if renter delays launch or return times by 15 minutes or more · $400 refundable security deposit required for daily pontoon rentals
